text:
devrel: Quick heads-up — launching the Open Source Plugins Sprint next Tue (May 6). We want maintainers to demo plugins that extend Redwood's model connectors, evals, or runtime adapters. Call for demos: 90s video + short PR link. Submit here: https://forms.redwood.ai/os-plugins-sprint (deadline May 2). We'll feature selected demos at Community Day and award a "maintainer" badge. :tada: 

maya: Love this — I'll post to the community channels and the social handle. Is there a short template for the demo video?

devrel: No strict template — focus on: 1) what it does, 2) why it's useful, 3) how to run locally. 90s max. We also have a sample script in the community-templates repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-templates/blob/main/demo-script.md :sparkles:

sam: Quick question about licensing — my plugin includes a couple of snippets from a third-party library. Any constraints?

alice: Good call. We ask that contributed plugins be under MIT or Apache-2.0 (or compatible). Please add a LICENSE file and note any upstream attributions in the PR. cc @legal-team if you need help.

release-bot: Reminder — early-bird review window closes in 48h. Submissions received before May 1 get priority feedback. Submit via the form: https://forms.redwood.ai/os-plugins-sprint 

devrel: We'll run an office hours session Thurs 16:00 PT to review demos/slides. RSVP here: https://calendar.redwood.ai/os-plugins-office-hours. Ping me in DMs if you want a quick review slot. :thumbsup:

maya: planning a short announcement post for the forum — will include the PR checklist and the form link.

devrel: Awesome, thanks everyone — excited to see what the community builds! :rocket:
